source: Official CTU IoT-23 timestamped Zeek conn.log.labeled scenarios

temporal_protocol.clean_history: All 16 preceding 30-second bins contain no malicious-labelled flow of any family.
temporal_protocol.heldout_rule: For each scored family, all blocks containing that family in history or future are excluded from train/calibration/policy.
temporal_protocol.negative_rule: Reserved test blocks with complete benign history and no attack in the future horizon.
temporal_protocol.split_rule: One-hour block-disjoint deterministic split; sequences used for train/calibration/policy cannot cross their block boundary.
temporal_protocol.threshold_rule: Threshold comes only from policy benign scores at a pre-enumerated FPR budget; no test-derived threshold.

allowed: flow count and temporal burst statistics
history trend delta volatility and acceleration

model_family_frozen_for_first_run: HistGradientBoostingClassifier over strict-network temporal summaries; StandardScaler and probability calibration fit on development only.
claim_boundary: Passing this development gate demonstrates warning on three attack behaviours excluded from each corresponding training/calibration/policy set. It is not a claim that every zero-day attack is detectable.
